channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Takeaways: Wild reach season-high goal total with 7-3 rout of Oilers
item.description: The Wild won their third game in a row and swept the three-game season series from Edmonton.

item.title: Timberwolves win fourth in a row with 131-114 victory over Grizzlies
item.description: The Wolves again took advantage of a shorthanded opponent, one they will face again in two days.

item.title: A few inches of snow coming with Sunday warm-up
item.description: Feb. 1 is looking to be the warmest day in two weeks with highs in the 20s — and maybe the 30s in southern Minnesota.

item.title: Reusse: Latest generation of Pohlads has made it clear Twins are a business
item.description: An organization that was thick with camaraderie for decades appears to be a different entity with Derek Falvey’s departure.

item.title: Vikings add to coaching staff, hiring former Dolphins offensive coordinator Frank Smith
item.description: The Vikings promoted Keith Carter to offensive line coach job, and veteran coaches Ryan Nielsen and Gerald Alexander joined Brian Flores’ defensive staff.

item.title: State agency whistleblowers say fraud concerns were ignored for years
item.description: Staff members at the Minnesota Department of Human Services say they’ve faced retaliation for bringing up red flags, long before social services fraud in Minnesota became national news.

item.title: Multiple buildings on fire after Hermantown blast
item.description: Too early to tell what caused Jan. 31 explosion, city official says.

item.title: The latest: Judges rebuke immigration crackdown, offer sympathy for Minnesota in twin rulings
item.description: The state’s initial bid to get the courts to halt Operation Metro Surge was unsuccessful. A federal judge ordered the release of 5-year-old Liam Ramos and his father.

item.title: ‘No humanity’: Detainees describe conditions inside Whipple Federal Building
item.description: Immigration sweep brings overcrowded rooms and overflowing toilets. Lawyers say they can’t visit their clients. The Department of Homeland Security says “all detainees receive full due process.”

item.title: Judge rules Columbia Heights boy and father must be released from Texas detention center
item.description: The ruling handed down Saturday sharply rebuked the Trump administration for “traumatizing children” and says the two must be freed by Tuesday.
